Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: A course purchase from a PROFESSIONAL trainer's course accrues the correct 70/30 split, reflected on My Revenue.
column3: 1. Complete a paid-course purchase for a course owned by a PROFESSIONAL trainer (builds on SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC11). 2. Log in as that trainer and open "Revenue & Settlement" (My Revenue).
column4: The sale's trainerEarnings equals 70% of the course price (30% platform fee); depending on the sale's age it appears under either the "7-Day Pending Hold" or "Available Balance" KPI card (see SYS_FLOW_REV_TC03), never lost.
column5: A PROFESSIONAL Trainer owns the purchased course (builds on SYS_FLOW_ENR's purchase flow).

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: A course purchase from a PEER_TUTOR trainer's course accrues the correct 60/40 split.
column3: 1. Complete a paid-course purchase for a course owned by a PEER_TUTOR trainer. 2. Open that trainer's "Revenue & Settlement" page.
column4: The sale's trainerEarnings equals 60% of the course price (40% platform fee), shown in the matching KPI card.
column5: A PEER_TUTOR Trainer owns the purchased course.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: The Revenue page's "7-Day Pending Hold" vs "Available Balance" split correctly reflects each unsettled sale's age.
column3: 1. As a trainer with a sale completed today, open My Revenue and confirm the "7-Day Pending Hold" figure includes it. 2. Using a sale/payment older than 7 days (e.g. via seeded test data), confirm that older unsettled sale instead appears under "Available Balance".
column4: Sales less than 7 days old (by Payment.createdAt) are excluded from Available Balance and counted only in Pending Hold; sales 7+ days old with settlementStatus still PENDING move into Available Balance; the two figures never double-count the same sale.
column5: At least one sale under 7 days old and one 7+ days old, both unsettled, for the same trainer.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: The Trainer Dashboard aggregates the trainer's own courses/learners/exams/revenue/rating and a 12-month revenue chart, defaulting to 0 rather than crashing when data is sparse.
column3: 1. Log in as a trainer with at least one course, some learners, and past payments. 2. Open the Trainer Dashboard (not the Revenue page) and inspect the KPI cards and the monthly revenue chart.
column4: Total Revenue, Total Learners (distinct across all courses), Active Courses, and Avg Rating all render real numbers, defaulting to 0 rather than null/crashing when a metric has no data; the revenue chart shows exactly 12 points (Jan-Dec of the current year), zero-filled for months with no revenue.
column5: Trainer owns >=1 course with some learners/payments.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: The Trainer Dashboard's "Recent Activity" feed merges payments, enrollments, and ratings into one recency-sorted list capped at 5 entries.
column3: 1. Ensure the trainer has more than 5 combined recent payments/enrollments/ratings events. 2. Open the Trainer Dashboard and inspect the recent-activity list.
column4: At most 5 entries are shown, drawn from the union of the most recent payments, enrollments, and ratings, re-sorted by recency and capped to 5 overall - not simply the 5 latest payments.
column5: At least 6 combined recent payment/enrollment/rating events exist for the trainer's courses.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: The Revenue page's "Salary Breakdown" info modal shows policy text matching the logged-in trainer's own TrainerType.
column3: 1. On the Revenue & Settlement page, tap "Salary Breakdown". 2. Read Article 1 (split ratio), Article 2 (10% PIT tax formula), and Article 3 (7-day hold policy).
column4: For a Teacher (PROFESSIONAL) the modal shows "70% Trainer Share / 30% HanGo Platform Fee"; for a Tutor (PEER_TUTOR) it shows "60%/40%"; the PIT and 7-day hold explanations match the same formulas verified in SYS_FLOW_REV_TC01-TC03.
column5: Logged in as a trainer with a known trainerType.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: Course Manager triggers the monthly cutoff, producing per-trainer statements for the covered period.
column3: 1. Log in as COURSE_MANAGER/ADMINISTRATOR and open Revenue Settlement Management > Monthly Statements tab. 2. Tap "Trigger Monthly Cutoff" for the current period.
column4: A success toast reports the number of trainers a statement was generated for; each affected trainer gets a new/updated MonthlyStatement row with the correct revenue-split amount and a StatementReady-style notification (cross-reference SYS_FLOW_NTF).
column5: At least one trainer has unsettled SUCCESS payments (settlementStatus=PENDING) in the period.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: Re-triggering the cutoff immediately for the same period is a safe re-run that upserts rather than duplicates, even reincorporating a statement's own not-yet-settled payments.
column3: 1. Immediately after SYS_FLOW_REV_TC07, tap "Trigger Monthly Cutoff" again for the same period.
column4: The same statement row per trainer is found and re-summed rather than duplicated; the trainer's figures are not doubled even though the statement from TC07 may already be PENDING_TRAINER_CONFIRM (the lookup doesn't gate on status).
column5: A statement was already generated for this period in SYS_FLOW_REV_TC07.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: Triggering cutoff when no trainer has eligible pending payments in the period is handled sanely, not silently fabricating data.
column3: 1. Pick a period/trainer combination known to have zero SUCCESS payments with settlementStatus=PENDING. 2. Tap "Trigger Monthly Cutoff" for that period.
column4: A "No pending orders found for cutoff" toast appears; no new statement rows are created; no crash.
column5: A period with no eligible pending payments.

column4: The visible rows narrow correctly for each filter and for all three combined; clearing a filter restores the wider list.
column5: Multiple statements exist across different trainers/statuses/periods.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: Trainer confirms a Pending-Confirm statement from the My Revenue table.

column4: A success toast appears; the row's status badge updates to "Confirmed (Awaiting Payout)"; the figures shown are unchanged from what was generated.
column5: A "Pending Trainer Confirm" statement exists for this trainer.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: Trainer rejects a statement with a required reason, and the Course Manager sees it flip into the "Recalculate & Resubmit" action.
column3: 1. On a different Pending-Confirm statement, tap "Reject". 2. Try submitting with an empty reason - confirm it is blocked. 3. Enter a reason (e.g. "Amount looks wrong") and confirm.
column4: Step 2 is blocked with a "Please enter a reason" toast. Step 3: status becomes "Rejected" with the reason stored in adminNotes; on the Course Manager's Settlement page this same statement's row action changes to "Recalculate & Resubmit" instead of "Mark Paid".
column5: A second "Pending Trainer Confirm" statement exists for this trainer.

column3: 1. On a "Pending Confirm" row in My Revenue, look for any editable amount/line-item field.
column4: Only "Confirm" and "Reject" buttons are present; the gross/tax/net figures are plain read-only text - disputing a wrong figure requires Reject-with-reason, not a self-service edit.
column5: A "Pending Trainer Confirm" statement exists.

Trainer Revenue- Monthly Statement & Set: Course Manager settles a statement via "Mark Paid", with client-side validation on the bank reference and receipt image before it is accepted.
column3: 1. On a non-PAID statement row, tap "Mark Paid" (or open its detail and tap "Mark as Paid"). 2. Try confirming with an empty Bank Transaction Reference - expect a block. 3. Enter a reference under 4 characters - expect a block. 4. Enter a valid reference but leave the receipt image empty - expect a block. 5. Try uploading a .webp receipt image - expect it rejected client-side with the WEBP-excluded message. 6. Upload a valid JPG/PNG receipt (confirm the AI OCR banner extracts/cross-checks a reference and amount), then tap "Confirm Paid".
column4: Steps 2-5 each block with their matching toast before any API call; step 6 succeeds - status becomes PAID, paidAt is set, the entered bank reference and receipt URL are stored, and the trainer is notified/emailed.
column5: A statement ready to settle exists (status PENDING_TRAINER_CONFIRM or TRAINER_CONFIRMED).

column3: 1. Generate a fresh statement (repeat SYS_FLOW_REV_TC07 for a new period) but skip the trainer-confirm step, leaving it "Pending Confirm". 2. As Course Manager, open that row - confirm the action button still reads "Mark Paid" (not disabled/hidden). 3. Complete the settle dialog as in SYS_FLOW_REV_TC15.
column4: The UI offers no gate at all - "Mark Paid" is shown identically for PENDING_TRAINER_CONFIRM and TRAINER_CONFIRMED rows, and settling succeeds regardless of whether the trainer ever confirmed (the lookup does not check confirmation state).
column5: A freshly generated, unconfirmed statement exists.

column5: A REJECTED (or CANCELLED) statement exists, from SYS_FLOW_REV_TC13.
